description: Windows startup manager for reviewing and controlling auto-start entries
pre_install: if (!(is_admin)) { error "$app requires administrator rights to $cmd"; break }

script: if (-not $entry) { Write-Host 'No machine-wide Autorun Organizer uninstall entry was found; skipping external uninstall.'; return }
if (-not $match.Success) { throw 'Could not determine the Autorun Organizer uninstaller path from its registry entry.' }
if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $uninstaller)) { throw "The Autorun Organizer uninstaller does not exist: $uninstaller" }
if ($process.ExitCode -ne 0) { throw "Autorun Organizer uninstaller exited with code $($process.ExitCode)." }

notes: Requires an elevated PowerShell session. The publisher's setup performs a normal Windows installation outside the Scoop app directory.

script: if (-not $match.Success) { throw 'Unable to detect the Autorun Organizer version from the official ChemTable product page.' }
